description: Load profiles of the record suite. A spec names one (suite.profile; default: the one named by default); every attempt records the cell's entry. single = the 1-agent cell on the era fixture (mixed, like every fixture-backed cell: one session continuing the fixture's history; the driver's size-aware distribution test decides a sample of one), empty = the 1-agent cell on an empty database (1e), ladder = every other level, where L is the level (agents) and {"ceil_div": n} is ceil(L / n). A record without an era fixture runs every cell fresh (history and mixed need fixture threads). common_driver_args go to the driver of every cell, after the profile's own. levels, where a profile has it, writes a level's counts out and wins over ladder's rule.

real3.description: Closer to real use: N agents watched by 3 subscribers (a desktop and a phone, say) that switch threads every 300 s, and pollers scaled as in the primary profile, ceil(N/4) at 0.01 calls/s, with a 60 s turn gap. levels writes the five published levels out; any other level follows ladder.

primary-scaled.description: The scaled primary profile: subscribers ceil(agents/10), pollers ceil(agents/4) at 0.01 calls/s, a thread switch every 300 s and a 60 s turn gap.
